verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid channels remain fully inactive this period.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads — all engagement came from Google Business Profile and organic search. Combined, the three locations generated 387 Google Business Profile actions (directions, calls, and web clicks) in the last 28 days, with O'Hare Precision accounting for the largest share at 192. GBP activity at both Forte Metals and Advance Grinding dropped sharply in the most recent week — down 72% and 80% respectively — while O'Hare held steady with a 5% week-over-week gain. We are reviewing the GBP listings at the two declining locations to identify and address any visibility issues. Website tracking is also being repaired across the account, as it is currently not recording sessions, which means web conversion data is unavailable this period.
